profiler.note: Both sm_100a and sm_103a remain distinct compiler targets. Measured on B300 sm_103a (148 SMs, 267 GB HBM3e) with nsys profile --gpu-metrics-frequency=200000 and 12-buffer cold-HBM ring (As[12], Bs[12]), rendering topmost [0-100%] hardware utilization at pid=1 / upid=1 / sort_index=-1000.

target.toolchain: nvcc 13.3 V13.3.73 and Triton 3.6.0; measured on NVIDIA B300 (sm_103a, 148 SMs, 267 GB HBM3e) at 179.92 TFLOPS (190.98 us), 0 spills, 0 C2 mismatches

platform_note: B300 has two machine targets. Compile and label sm_100a and sm_103a separately; never merge their captures or evidence. On B300 sm_103a (148 SMs, 267 GB HBM3e), Warp-Specialized 2-WarpGroup GEMM (Producer_DMA warps 0..3 cp.async.cg.shared.global + cp.async.mbarrier.arrive.noinc.shared.b64; Consumer_MMA warps 4..7 mbarrier.try_wait.parity.shared.b64 + MMA + mbarrier.arrive.shared.b64) uses FI_GRAN=0 warp-level recording with group="sm" physical SM swimlanes, branchless predicated PTX fi_record_pred (FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED) + hoisted overflow atomicOr in fi_close, measuring 179.92 TFLOPS (190.98 us) with 0 spills and 0 C2 mismatches.

evidence_summary.scope: Per-semantic statuses describe the availability of target-specific evidence for ISA/recorder guidance; B300 sm_103a is measured on-card (179.92 TFLOPS, 190.98 us, 200 kHz GSP metrics) while sm_100a remains cross-compiled.

supporting_evidence: cp.async.mbarrier.arrive.noinc.shared.b64 + mbarrier.try_wait.parity.shared.b64 (Warp-Specialized 2-WarpGroup GEMM on sm_103a: 179.92 TFLOPS, 190.98 us)
tcgen05.guidance: Use tcgen05 or Warp-Specialized 2-WarpGroup MMA when the target artifact demonstrates it. Issue and completion are distinct; end MMA spans after the completion wait, and always use .noinc on cp.async.mbarrier.arrive.noinc.shared.b64 to prevent expected-arrival-count doubling deadlock.

wgmma.guidance: No B300 wgmma evidence is present in the owned cards. H20 wgmma evidence does not transfer. Probe sm_100a and sm_103a independently before labeling a B300 artifact as wgmma.

recorder.api_family: FI_B / FI_E / FI_M / FI_BG_PRED / FI_EG_PRED / FI_OPEN / FI_CLOSE
recorder.open_close: FI_OPEN installs the lane/wave/CTA recorder predicate; FI_CLOSE is required on every executed exit path and hoists the overflow atomicOr out of the K-loop.
fits: ABI tag fields must match the selected recorder. Do not invent a new event layout in the recipe.
notes: Use one logical begin/end pair per selected semantic interval.

Pillar I & II (v14 <= 10% perturbation engine): Inside hot K-loops, use FI_TIMER=1 dual-anchor affine local clock (%clock64 calibrated by FI_OPEN/FI_CLOSE (t_global, c_local) anchors) and branchless predicated PTX fi_record_pred via FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED without ': "memory"' clobber (~166 regs vs 239 regs), electing 1 leader per 128-thread WarpGroup role via FI_OPEN_BY((lin_tid & 127u) == 0u, role) and hoisting overflow atomicOr to fi_close.

Pillar III & IV: auto_gemm.py evaluates S in {full(1), stride4(4), stride8(8)} to select the densest stride S* with Measured_Overhead(S*) <= 10.0% (enforced by fi_trace_gate.py G1-G5) while isolating host fi_reset outside steady-state timing loops.
Keep aux stable between pair members so waits and phases can be correlated.
The device recorder can only carry a 32-bit aux; move larger descriptors to names.json or the capture metadata.

source_recognition_policy.resolution: Assign a semantic ID only after reading the enclosing dataflow and the operator/task boundary.

correctness_hazards: SASS/ISA disturbance: instrumentation and surrounding code motion can change instruction count, register allocation, spills, vector width, and the selected tensor-core or copy family. Compile FI_LEVEL=0/1/2 and compare the final SASS.
Divergence/mask: a recorder in a divergent branch can produce unpaired records or deadlock a barrier. Preserve the original predicate and use the target wave size for lane selection.
Buffer overflow: fixed slots can fill or point out of range. Require the device overflow bits to be zero, records per lane to stay below cap, and no ring/wrap behavior.

Asynchronous completion: cp.async, TMA, tcgen05, and collectives have issue and completion boundaries that are not interchangeable. wgmma remains unverified for B300 and must not be inferred from H20.
Correctness drift: moving code across predicates, fences, or waits can change numerical results or visibility even when the kernel still runs.
validation_requirements: Parse all JSON and validate this document against configs/validation/schemas/recipe.schema.json.
Use only semantic IDs present in configs/semantic_ids.json; display names must exactly equal their IDs.
Compile off, entry-only, and full builds with Python 3.10 orchestration where applicable; compare final SASS and register/spill metrics.
Run full-output correctness against an uninstrumented reference with tail, mask, dtype, and shape cases for the selected operator.
Verify cap, slot count, records per lane, overflow bits, and trace completeness.
Capture the selected hardware evidence with the card profiler and keep B300 sm_100a/sm_103a evidence separate.

attention score stabilization before probabilities feed the value product

placement.end: After the normalized probabilities are ready for their consumer; use one matching interval per selected softmax subtask.

notes: Use EV_SOFTMAX from the canonical event constants; do not define a local numeric tag.
